profile.model: Flagship originates companies entirely in-house: small partner-led teams pose speculative 'what if' questions, run stealth explorations, and spin promising ones into ProtoCos and then NewCos that Flagship funds and staffs itself before bringing in outside investors. It launches roughly 6–8 companies a year around bioplatforms and patentable white space, and increasingly applies the model beyond human health to agriculture and AI.
profile.summary: Flagship is the archetypal biotech venture studio, having originated 120+ companies including Moderna and producing about 25 IPOs since 2013. With roughly $14B under management and newer bets like Lila Sciences and Generate:Biomedicines, it sets the template for AI-era company creation.
